/**

 * `sovereign-dark` → `sovereign-obsidian`, `royal-gold` → `royal-gold-3d`.

  if (id === "sovereign-dark") return "sovereign-obsidian";
  if (id === "royal-gold") return "royal-gold-3d";
  if (id && VALID_THEME_IDS.has(id as HubThemeId)) {

  }
  return DEFAULT_HUB_THEME;
}
